articles.summary: Lennar priced $600M of senior notes on Oct. 13, 2026: $300M 5.700% due 2029 (T+80) and $300M 5.950% due 2032 (T+95). Net proceeds about $594.5M for general corporate purposes; expected settlement Oct. 15.
articles.why_it_matters: Lennar, a named Domain relationship, can still borrow unsecured for three to five years at under 6%, which is the cost of capital any land-bank proposal to it is measured against.

suggested_update.text: Priced $600M of senior notes on 2026-10-13: $300M 5.700% due October 2029 and $300M 5.950% due January 2032, net proceeds about $594.5M for general corporate purposes.

articles.summary: Dream Finders closed its Beazer Homes acquisition on Oct. 20, 2026 at $33.50 a share, about $878.4M. Funding: a $572.1M Millrose land bank facility and $675M of Series B convertible preferred. Beazer's $350M 2029 notes are being redeemed.
articles.why_it_matters: Millrose and Kennedy Lewis put $572.1M of land-bank capital behind a top-25 builder merger, taking Beazer's land onto a competitor's platform and showing Millrose will fund acquisition financing, not only lot takedowns.

suggested_update.text: Closed the acquisition of Beazer Homes on 2026-10-20 ($33.50 a share, about $878.4M) funded by a $572.1M land bank facility from Millrose Properties and/or affiliates and $675M of Series B convertible preferred.

articles.summary: Beazer's own 8-K on the Oct. 20, 2026 merger close: now a wholly owned Dream Finders subsidiary, NYSE delisting requested, JPMorgan credit agreement terminated and repaid, $350M 7.250% notes due 2029 being redeemed, board replaced by Dream Finders designees.
articles.why_it_matters: Beazer no longer exists as a separate public counterparty: its land decisions now run through Dream Finders, whose merger financing came from Millrose.

suggested_update.text: Acquired by Dream Finders Homes on 2026-10-20 at $33.50 a share in cash; now a wholly owned subsidiary, delisting from the NYSE, with its credit facility repaid and $350M 7.250% notes due 2029 redeemed.

articles.summary: Pricing term sheet for Lennar's $600M notes, trade date Oct. 13, 2026: 5.700% due 2029 at 99.929 (T+80) and 5.950% due 2032 at 99.948 (T+95). Expected ratings Baa2 / BBB / BBB+ (Fitch outlook negative).
articles.why_it_matters: Same Lennar note sale as the final prospectus supplement; the spreads here are the benchmark for what Lennar pays for unsecured money versus land-bank capital.

articles.summary: Preliminary prospectus supplement, dated Oct. 13, 2026, for the same two-tranche Lennar senior note sale, with amounts and coupons blank. It states that at Aug. 31, 2026 Lennar owned about 2% of its homesites and controlled 98% by option.
articles.why_it_matters: Superseded by the final terms, but it confirms Lennar is 98% optioned, so nearly all of its land need is already third-party financed and open to land bankers.

articles.summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp.'s third-quarter 2026 10-Q, filed Nov. 5, matched a full-text search for "land banking". The filing was not opened, so what the mention refers to is unconfirmed.
articles.why_it_matters: Blue Owl-managed funds formed a land banking partnership with Five Point's Hearthstone in February 2026, so Blue Owl vehicles are a source of competing land-bank capital; whether this fund holds that exposure is not confirmed here.

articles.summary: Blue Owl Capital Corp.'s (OBDC) third-quarter 2026 10-Q, filed Nov. 4, matched a full-text search for "land banking". The filing was not opened, so what the mention refers to is unconfirmed.
articles.why_it_matters: Blue Owl-managed funds back Five Point's Hearthstone land banking platform, so a land banking line in a Blue Owl lender's quarterly report may show how much competing capital is deployed; not confirmed for this fund.

articles.summary: Invitation Homes' third-quarter 2026 10-Q, filed Oct. 29, matched a full-text search for "land banking". The filing was not opened and the context of the mention is unconfirmed.
articles.why_it_matters: Invitation Homes has run a lending program for homebuilders since 2025, so a land banking mention could mean a rental landlord is edging into builder land finance; unconfirmed until the filing is read.

articles.summary: Starwood Capital Group and Trez Capital formed a partnership, announced Nov. 3, 2026, to originate residential land acquisition and development loans for single-family communities across the US. Trade reports cite a target above $1B a year, seeded with about $450M.
articles.why_it_matters: Starwood's institutional capital behind Trez's land lending platform is a new, scaled source of money for builder and developer lots that competes directly with Domain's land-bank offer on the same deals.

articles.summary: Five Point's third-quarter 2026 10-Q, filed Oct. 23. Its Oct. 22 results release shows the Hearthstone land banking platform at about $3.4B under management with $6.5M of quarterly management fees ($18.2M year to date); consolidated net loss $4.4M, liquidity $576.2M.
articles.why_it_matters: Hearthstone is a rival land banker now backed by Blue Owl-managed funds, and this is the quarterly read on its size and fee income against Domain's own book.

articles.summary: Lincoln Property Company and McCourt Partners secured $133M of construction financing for a mixed-use project at 11111 Jefferson Blvd. in Culver City, California, per the snippet.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a commercial mixed-use construction loan, caught only because the headline uses the words land and financing.

articles.summary: Kingston, New York's planning board reviewed the Kingston City Land Bank's first multi-family project, ten units split between five townhomes and five apartments.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a municipal land bank that recycles vacant property, not a financier of homebuilder lots.

articles.summary: A Vermont state housing agency report says a public land bank could help ease the state's housing shortage, with how to fund it still unresolved.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a proposed government land bank, not private lot-option capital for builders.

articles.summary: Springfield, Missouri plans to use a Missouri Foundation for Health grant to set up a municipal land bank, pending city council approval; council heard details on Nov. 16.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a city blight-remediation land bank, unrelated to financing homebuilder land.

articles.summary: A Seeking Alpha contributor rates Lennar a buy at 0.92 times book value, arguing cost cuts and the land-light shift will lift margins as pricing stabilizes and high-cost land works through results.
articles.why_it_matters: A stock-pick opinion with no new facts about Lennar's land or optioned lots; nothing for Domain to act on.

articles.summary: The Wilmington Neighborhood Conservancy Land Bank in Delaware reached a milestone in renovating homes in the city's Hilltop neighborhood.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a municipal land bank renovating houses, not builder lot finance.

articles.summary: The Steuben County Land Bank in New York is demolishing some run-down properties in Hornell and renovating others.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a county blight program that shares only the words land bank.

articles.summary: A Detroit News opinion column argues that the Detroit Land Bank reforms announced by Mayor Mary Sheffield will only succeed if they lead to local residents owning homes.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: an opinion piece on a city-run land bank, not builder land finance.

articles.summary: Caddo Parish, Louisiana is looking for an expert to guide the creation of a parish land bank to deal with blighted vacant properties.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a government land bank for blighted property, not a competitor or a customer.

articles.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador's liquor corporation recalled one production lot of a Landwash Brewery lager called Smiling Land Light.
articles.why_it_matters: No bearing on Domain: a beer recall matched by accident on the words land, light and lot.
